knowledge:
- key_parameters: cqvfile=Path to the internal CQV file (e.g., "Xba.CQV") used for normalization ;; probefiledir=Directory containing the .raw files (defaults to working directory if not specified) ;; start=In create_Thetafile, specifies the index of the first SNP to process ;; end=In create_Thetafile, specifies the index of the last SNP to process (default is -1, which processes all SNPs) ;; thetafile=Output/input ASCII text file storing theta A and theta B estimates ;; regionsfile=Path to the internal regions file (e.g., "Xba.regions") containing genotype group centers and covariance matrices ;; genotypefile=Output file path for classification results ;; callrate=Cut-off value to make accurate calls (eligible values: 80, 82, 84, 86, 88, 90, 92, 94, 96, 98, 100; default is 100; ineligible values default to 80) ;; plotfile=File path to save the plot (e.g., "plots.ps"); if empty string "", displays onscreen ;; snpsfile=Text file containing a list of SNPs to plot (one per line)
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Appropriate for performing supervised genotype calling on Affymetrix Mapping 100K array (Xba set) data when raw probe intensity files and reference training files are available.
- pitfalls: Currently only works for the 100K-Xba dataset and does not support Hind, 500K, or 10K datasets in this version ;; Requires specific internal files (Xba.CQV and Xba.regions) downloaded from the author's website to function ;; Requires converting binary .CEL files to ASCII .raw files first using an external Affymetrix tool (gtype_cel_to_pq) ;; In plot_theta, Pick.Obj must always be set to FALSE for RLMM version 0.7 ;; Specifying an ineligible call rate (e.g., 91) will automatically reset it to the minimum of 80%.

workflows.name: affymetrix_xba_genotyping
workflows.intent: Normalize raw probe intensities, estimate theta values, classify genotypes, and plot allele summaries for Affymetrix 100K-Xba SNP arrays.
input: snps.lst (text file listing SNPs to plot)
.raw files (ASCII converted CEL files in the working directory)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the RLMM library ;; 2. Normalize raw probe intensity files using normalize_Rawfiles ;; 3. Estimate theta A and theta B values using create_Thetafile ;; 4. Classify genotypes using Classify with Mahalanobis distance ;; 5. Plot allele summaries for specific SNPs using plot_theta
